A small school with a big heart
Wildmoor Heath Primary School
Wildmoor Heath Primary School is a thriving, community primary school in the village of Crowthorne, Berkshire.
We are extremely proud to welcome you to Wildmoor Heath Primary School in Crowthorne, Berkshire and to our caring and successful learning community, where children are at the heart of everything we do. We strive to provide the best primary school education possible for our children.
As you enter Wildmoor Heath, you will immediately know that you are in a unique school where the children’s enthusiasm shines through. Alongside an ambitious academic curriculum, we enrich learning with inspiring trips, experiences and pupil leadership roles, linked to our curriculum enrichment areas of Community, Communication, Environment, Wellbeing and Opportunities. Additionally, children learn important life skills, through our school values of Respect, Honesty, Resilience and Independence.
At Wildmoor, we are committed to delivering an excellent education in an exceptional outdoor environment, where every child has the opportunity to achieve the highest level of success. With links to the local secondary schools in Crowthorne (Edgbarrow School and Wellington College), children have the opportunity to experience activities in larger school settings, helping them prepare for secondary school at the end of their seven-year journey at Wildmoor Heath.
With supportive parents and a highly experienced and dedicated team of staff who collaborate very effectively, children are inspired to aim high, achieve their best and feel proud of themselves.
Delve into our website to see what makes our school so unique!
We would love to show you our amazing school. Please contact the school office on 01344 772034 or email reception@wildmoorheath.org.uk to book a school tour. We look forward to seeing you!

Wellbeing
At Wildmoor Heath School, we are committed to supporting the positive mental health and wellbeing of our whole school community (children, staff, parents and carers).
We have a supportive and caring ethos and our approach is respectful and kind, where each individual and each contribution is valued.
We endeavour to ensure that children are able to manage times of change and stress and aim to ensure that they are supported to reach their potential or to access help when they need it.
We also have a role in ensuring that children learn about what they can do to maintain positive mental health, what affects their mental health, how they can help reduce the stigma surrounding mental health issues, and where they can go if they need help and support.
At Wildmoor, we know that everyone experiences life challenges that can make us vulnerable and, at times, anyone may need additional emotional support. We take the view that positive mental health is everybody’s business and that we all have a role to play.
Teaching about mental health
At Wildmoor Heath School, we take a whole school approach to promoting positive mental health, aiming to help children become more resilient, happy and successful and to work in a proactive way to avoid problems arising.
